pe_assessment: Frozen October 6 snapshot: trailing P/E 16.83 x, forward P/E 14.59 x (vendor estimate), dividend yield 3.85% (vendor reported). Inference:earnings/debt/cash balance produces neutral; no unverified utility fair value.

Q2operating margin 11.44% vs 12.58%, with FX translation 2.1mloss vs 318.4mgain. H1operating profit 4.539 bn vs 4.439 bn indicates underlying operating resilience despite bottom line pressure.
debt_analysis: Borrowings RM60.936 bn excluding leases 31.198 bn; cash/deposits 15.280 bn. H1CFO11.9525 bn minusPP&E7.2199 bn/investment property 21 m yields 4.7116 bn pre-financing FCF. Subtract finance cost 1.4172 bn, lease principal 789.2 m/lease interest 703.4 m gives 1.8018 bn, covering dividend 1.6322 bn narrowly. Deposits include restricted/longer tenor balances; cashflowC&E13.1731 bn.
growth_outlook: Inference: disclosed cash generation supports large grid investment anddividends, but 16.83 x trailing earnings/3.85% reported yield must be weighed against profit decline, debt/leases and regulated returns. Strong CFO is not alone proof all capex earns its cost of capital.
key_risks: Large borrowings plus leases and heavy capital spend.
Bottom line earnings decline, FXvolatility and tariff/fuel adjustment timing; post financing dividend coverage narrow.
key_strengths: CFO11.9525 bn coverscashPP&E and modest investment property spend.
H1operating profitgrew andliquidity/net current liabilities improved.
summary: Tenaga’s full cash flow statement verifies funding capacity for investment anddividends, correcting the earlier extraction gap. Neutral/medium balances that cash strength against high lease-inclusive debt, profit decline and regulated return uncertainty at the frozen valuation.
